'''Warmoon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. [[Fyodoi]] believed that when the Warmoon was full, it was a good time to engage in battle, which included hunting the [[Galidyn]].
